# SPARQL cookbook

<!-- Generated by scripts/render_docs.py from mahabharata_characters.ttl. Edit the data, not this text. -->

Each query below was run against `mahabharata_characters.ttl` with rdflib when this page was generated, and the result shown is what it returned. The queries use these prefixes:

```sparql
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX mb:   <https://mahabharata.tanay.uk/>
PREFIX mbh:  <https://mahabharata.tanay.uk/characters#>
PREFIX mbhx: <https://mahabharata.tanay.uk/schema#>
```

Run one with rdflib (`Graph().parse('mahabharata_characters.ttl').query(q)`) or with Apache Jena (`arq --data=mahabharata_characters.ttl --query=q.rq`). No inference is needed for any of them; where the inverse of a relation is wanted, the query uses an inverse property path instead.

## 1. Who did Arjuna kill, and on which day of the war?

`mbhx:killedBy` is stated on the one who was killed, so Arjuna is the object.

```sparql
SELECT ?name ?day WHERE {
  ?c mbhx:killedBy mbh:arjuna ;
     skos:prefLabel ?name .
  OPTIONAL { ?c mbhx:fellOnWarDay ?day }
  FILTER(lang(?name) = "en")
} ORDER BY ?day ?name
```

| name | day |
|---|---|
| Bhishma | 10 |
| Bhagadatta | 12 |
| Jayadratha | 14 |
| Sudakshina | 14 |
| Karna | 17 |
| Vrishasena | 17 |
| Susharma | 18 |

## 2. Who did Bhima kill? (the other direction)

The inverse `mbhx:killed` is declared in the schema but not written out in the data. Without an inference step, use the inverse property path `^mbhx:killedBy`.

```sparql
SELECT ?name WHERE {
  mbh:bhima ^mbhx:killedBy ?c .
  ?c skos:prefLabel ?name .
  FILTER(lang(?name) = "en")
} ORDER BY ?name
```

10 results: Bahlika, Bakasura, Duryodhana, Dushasana, Hidimba, Jarasandha, Jatasura, Kichaka, Kirmira, Vikarna.

## 3. Descendants of Shantanu, by stated parentage

A property path over `mbhx:childOf` walks the family tree. Fatherhood by niyoga and divine fathering are both recorded as `childOf`, so the Pandavas appear through Pandu.

```sparql
SELECT ?name WHERE {
  ?c mbhx:childOf+ mbh:shantanu ;
     skos:prefLabel ?name .
  FILTER(lang(?name) = "en")
} ORDER BY ?name
```

29 results: Abhimanyu, Arjuna, Babruvahana, Bhima, Bhishma, Chitrangada (son of Shantanu), Dhritarashtra, Durmasena, Duryodhana, Dushasana, Dussala, Ghatotkacha, Iravan, Janamejaya, Lakshmana Kumara, Nakula, Pandu, Parikshit, Prativindhya, Sahadeva, Shatanika, Shrutakarma, Shrutasena, Sutasoma, Vichitravirya, Vidura, Vikarna, Yudhishthira, Yuyutsu.

## 4. Who fell on day 14, and to whom?

Day 14 ends with the night battle, so it is the day with most recorded deaths.

```sparql
SELECT ?fallen ?killer WHERE {
  ?c mbhx:fellOnWarDay 14 ;
     skos:prefLabel ?fallen .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?c mbhx:killedBy ?k .
    ?k skos:prefLabel ?killer .
    FILTER(lang(?killer) = "en")
  }
  FILTER(lang(?fallen) = "en")
} ORDER BY ?fallen
```

| fallen | killer |
|---|---|
| Alambusha | Ghatotkacha |
| Bahlika | Bhima |
| Bhurishravas | Satyaki |
| Durmasena |  |
| Ghatotkacha | Karna |
| Jayadratha | Arjuna |
| Somadatta | Satyaki |
| Sudakshina | Arjuna |
| Vikarna | Bhima |

## 5. Find a character from any spelling

Hidden labels hold common English spellings, so a search can match on any label property.

```sparql
SELECT ?concept ?preferred WHERE {
  ?concept (skos:prefLabel|skos:altLabel|skos:hiddenLabel) "Bheem"@en ;
           skos:prefLabel ?preferred .
  FILTER(lang(?preferred) = "en")
}
```

| concept | preferred |
|---|---|
| `mbh:bhima` | Bhima |

## 6. How many characters sit under each grouping of the House of Kuru?

`skos:broader*` from a grouping up to the top concept selects every grouping of the branch; the count is of characters placed directly under each one, so the Upapandavas are counted under their own grouping and not under Children of the Pandavas.

```sparql
SELECT ?grouping (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?characters) WHERE {
  ?c a mbhx:Character ;
     skos:broader ?g .
  ?g skos:broader* mbh:house-of-kuru ;
     skos:prefLabel ?grouping .
  FILTER(lang(?grouping) = "en")
} GROUP BY ?grouping ORDER BY ?grouping
```

| grouping | characters |
|---|---|
| Children of the Kauravas | 2 |
| Children of the Pandavas | 4 |
| Consorts of the Pandavas | 5 |
| House of Kuru: generation of Pandu | 6 |
| House of Kuru: generation of Shantanu | 8 |
| House of Kuru: kings after the war | 2 |
| Kauravas | 5 |
| Pandavas | 5 |
| Upapandavas | 5 |

## 7. Characters placed under more than one grouping

The hierarchy is a polyhierarchy: a character belongs to the house of birth and to the house or role acquired by marriage, adoption or incarnation.

```sparql
SELECT ?name (GROUP_CONCAT(?g; separator=" · ") AS ?groupings) WHERE {
  ?c a mbhx:Character ;
     skos:prefLabel ?name ;
     skos:broader ?gr .
  ?gr skos:prefLabel ?g .
  FILTER(lang(?name) = "en" && lang(?g) = "en")
} GROUP BY ?name HAVING (COUNT(?gr) > 1) ORDER BY ?name
```

| name | groupings |
|---|---|
| Ambalika | House of Kuru: generation of Shantanu · Royal house of Kashi |
| Ambika | House of Kuru: generation of Shantanu · Royal house of Kashi |
| Babruvahana | Children of the Pandavas · Royal house of Manipura |
| Bahlika | House of Kuru: generation of Shantanu · Royal house of Bahlika |
| Chitrangada (princess of Manipura) | Consorts of the Pandavas · Royal house of Manipura |
| Draupadi | Consorts of the Pandavas · Royal house of Panchala |
| Gandhari | House of Kuru: generation of Pandu · Royal house of Gandhara |
| Ghatotkacha | Children of the Pandavas · Rakshasas |
| Hidimbi | Consorts of the Pandavas · Rakshasas |
| Karna | Royal house of Anga · Sutas |
| Krishna | Yadavas · Deities and celestial beings |
| Kunti | House of Kuru: generation of Pandu · Yadavas |
| Madri | House of Kuru: generation of Pandu · Royal house of Madra |
| Subhadra | Consorts of the Pandavas · Yadavas |
| Ulupi | Consorts of the Pandavas · Nagas |

## 8. Teachers and their students

`mbhx:studentOf` is stated on the student.

```sparql
SELECT ?teacher (GROUP_CONCAT(?student; separator=", ") AS ?students) WHERE {
  ?s mbhx:studentOf ?t .
  ?t skos:prefLabel ?teacher .
  ?s skos:prefLabel ?student .
  FILTER(lang(?teacher) = "en" && lang(?student) = "en")
} GROUP BY ?teacher ORDER BY ?teacher
```

| teacher | students |
|---|---|
| Arjuna | Satyaki |
| Balarama | Bhima, Duryodhana |
| Bhishma | Yudhishthira |
| Drona | Yudhishthira, Bhima, Arjuna, Nakula, Sahadeva, Duryodhana, Dushasana, Karna, Ashwatthama |
| Durvasa | Kunti |
| Kripa | Parikshit |
| Parashurama | Bhishma, Karna, Drona |
| Vyasa | Vaishampayana |

## 9. Who cursed whom

`mbhx:cursed` is one of the narrative relations; the curses drive several turns of the plot.

```sparql
SELECT ?who ?whom WHERE {
  ?a mbhx:cursed ?b .
  ?a skos:prefLabel ?who .
  ?b skos:prefLabel ?whom .
  FILTER(lang(?who) = "en" && lang(?whom) = "en")
} ORDER BY ?who
```

| who | whom |
|---|---|
| Gandhari | Krishna |
| Krishna | Ashwatthama |
| Parashurama | Karna |
| Urvashi | Arjuna |

## 10. Wikidata identifiers for the Pandavas

Every character with a Wikipedia article carries `skos:exactMatch` to its Wikidata item and DBpedia resource; filter on the namespace to pick one.

```sparql
SELECT ?name ?wikidata WHERE {
  ?c skos:broader mbh:pandavas ;
     skos:prefLabel ?name ;
     skos:exactMatch ?wikidata .
  FILTER(lang(?name) = "en" && STRSTARTS(STR(?wikidata), "http://www.wikidata.org/"))
} ORDER BY ?name
```

| name | wikidata |
|---|---|
| Arjuna | [Q185790](http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q185790) |
| Bhima | [Q3651886](http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q3651886) |
| Nakula | [Q1978476](http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q1978476) |
| Sahadeva | [Q2044641](http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q2044641) |
| Yudhishthira | [Q983067](http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q983067) |
